subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the following statement.**

We should be together to fight any danger. Otherwise, separately, we won't be able to fight.

options.text: United we stand, divided we fall.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'United we stand, divided we fall'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate idiom for the given statement would be** "united we stand, divided we fall."**
 
• This **idiom** highlights **the importance of unity in facing challenges or dangers**. It means that when people come together and stay united, they are stronger and more likely to overcome difficulties. Conversely, if people are divided or separated, they are weaker and more likely to fail.
 
• So, in the context of the statement, **it emphasizes the necessity of unity to effectively combat any danger.​**

**Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Under a cloud: This idiom is used to describe a situation or person that is under suspicion or in disfavor. For example, if someone is suspected of doing something wrong, they can be said to be "under a cloud."
 
• Up a blind alley: This phrase signifies a course of action that leads nowhere or has no prospects of positive outcome. It's like following a path that leads to a dead-end, symbolizing wasted efforts or a situation with no positive solution in sight.
 
• Well begun is half done: This saying means that a good start to a task or project makes it easier to complete. It emphasizes the importance of starting work with strong preparation or effort, suggesting that a task is halfway to completion if its beginning is handled well.
